scope_note: Each ABI row, including constructor/receive/generated getter, maps to >=3 static scenarios. These are not executed test counts or proof of exploit absence.

constructor.reviewed_property: Fixed dependency/parent/controller identity; admission is not production qualification.
scenarios: Zero/EOA/mismatched parent/controller/Registry/venue wiring rejects where required. A valid immutable child cannot be replaced by an unrelated caller.
Wrong home chain/recipient/runtime/feed policy or repeated child creation must not leave a partly initialized canonical component.
Deploying a compatible ABI alone does not qualify proxy controls, provider independence, actual liquidity or marketplace support.
constructor.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

constant.reviewed_property: Typed immutable bounds/profile constants do not authorize financial actions.
scenarios: Every caller reads the same exact fixed ABI value without mutation or authorization.
Pause/preparation/retirement must not be inferred from a constant: it describes code, not current availability.
An impostor can copy constants; consumers still require actual runtime/controller/helper bindings and explicit profile.
constant.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

binding.reviewed_property: Read-only identity must match reviewed actual wiring, not a manifest label.
scenarios: Any caller can read the fixed identity but cannot configure, replace or execute the dependency through the getter.
A failing/obsolete dependency cannot be repaired by relabeling this getter; immutable replacements require a fresh reviewed deployment.
Matching code/address alone does not authenticate proxy/admin controls or authorize signing; lifecycle and profile remain separate.
binding.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

stored.reviewed_property: Raw storage reads preserve absent/default versus initialized economic objects.
scenarios: Query an absent key/NFT/pool and preserve the exact default zero/false tuple instead of inventing positive backing or eligibility.
Compare valid records across their allowed lifecycle changes; stale historical keys and profiles must not be silently reinterpreted.
Arbitrary callers only read: financial consumers still check existence, canonical status, owner/pool identity and actual share denominator.
stored.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

history.reviewed_property: Append-only identity/count/ordinal reads cannot activate or overwrite policy history.
scenarios: Ordinal0/last valid/count boundary either returns the exact historical identity or rejects out-of-bounds; no aliasing or truncation.
Disable/re-enable and returning to identical parameters preserve original history rather than overwrite old records.
Reading a past identity never makes it current or qualifies its external dependency; compare the explicit active pointer.
history.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

source-set.reviewed_property: Only fixed ZZZ/native ETH contribution identities, with separately governed source eligibility.
scenarios: Wrong caller, alternate/zero/repeated ZZZ identity, missing review hash, changed code/precision or bad current dual prices rejects.
Disabling does not query a broken token/feed; re-enabling validates afresh and pool admission cannot undo an existing disable.
A third pool currency, WETH alias or royalty currency cannot become a contribution input or replace the fixed ZZZ after seal.
source-set.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

source-read.reviewed_property: Identity eligibility is not the same as an enabled, pinned, priceable source policy.
scenarios: Positive unsupported/disabled input fails; native zero address uses the explicit sentinel/18decimals, not nonexistent token code.
Zero amount returns0 without a dependency read; positive value requires policy/runtime/precision and both valid USD sources.
Disabling a source blocks both direct Vault and Entry funding but does not erase existing principal/reward accounting.
source-read.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

factory.reviewed_property: A unique child per caller cannot become the real Registry child by impersonation.
scenarios: Repeated create by the same caller rejects and preserves its original assetsOf record.
An unrelated caller creating a child cannot overwrite the Registry mapping or change the child immutable controller/Registry.
Factory/child creation gives no token configuration, sealed binding replacement, fund custody or generic execution permission.
factory.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

route-set.reviewed_property: Typed append-only routes pin real currencies/venue and can be disabled without failed dependencies.
scenarios: Wrong caller, arbitrary source/output/recipient/calldata, same currency, hook/dynamic fee, missing review or changed runtime/wiring rejects.
Duplicate IDs cannot replace history; stop does not consult a failed venue/token and re-enable fully revalidates current state.
Route approval does not admit an LP pool or third contribution token; an earlier quote cannot authorize a disabled route.
route-set.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

route-read.reviewed_property: Route reads preserve codec and existence without implying executable approval.
scenarios: Unknown route policy/validate rejects; existence/kind/enabled predicates preserve specified0/false rather than infer a codec.
A disabled known policy remains historical; validation/execution still rejects and v3/v4 records cannot be interchanged.
A policy read alone is not enough: actual code, manager/factory/key, static fee and enabled identity are rechecked before execution.
route-read.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

entry.reviewed_property: Exact owner-source contribution and actual marginal LP must commit or revert atomically.
scenarios: Wrong owner/operator/deadline/value/source/route, zero minLiquidity/amount, below100USD activation/5USD growth or stronger pool bound rejects.
Pull/conversion/approval/reset/refund callbacks altering owner, price fingerprints, captured limits, spot, lifecycle or exact baselines cannot produce unreviewed success.
Thin/empty pools, partial fills, fee shocks, excessive idle or insufficient net/marginal deployed value revert swaps/LP/membership/fees; caller gas is separate.
Pre-existing Entry/Manager/PosM/Vault balances cannot pay input or subsidize the floor; allowances reset and new shares preserve incumbents.
entry.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

entry-context.reviewed_property: Only one exact live fixed Vault/Registry/Pricing call can adopt original source USD.
scenarios: Wrong caller, inactive context, substituted NFT/pool/amounts/call hash/owner/gross USD cannot authorize contribution context.
Before Vault approval and after Vault return the Entry context stays inactive; final approval resets remain bracketed by pricing checks.
Ownership transfer during conversion/context validation rejects; NFT approval alone is never authority to spend an owner contribution.
entry-context.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

receive.reviewed_property: Only expected native settlement credit is counted, while forced prefunds remain separate.
scenarios: Arbitrary EOA/token/router/direct native sender rejects outside its authenticated fixed window/module identity.
Wrong sender, extra output, callback injection or unexpected forced ETH inside a measured window cannot satisfy exact settlement deltas.
Earlier force-sent native balance remains an unattributed baseline; valid credits cannot sweep or count it as user input/fees.
receive.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

oracle-set.reviewed_property: Two fresh reviewed sources and exact integer agreement, without a stale/single-source fallback.
scenarios: Wrong caller, duplicate source/independence ID, changed code/precision, malformed/stale/future/nonpositive round or missing review rejects.
Exact maxAge/deviation/precision boundaries reject one raw unit beyond policy; lower-price denominator and rounding are conservative.
Old records remain immutable; two equal answers or proxy code pins do not prove upstream independence or immutable administration.
oracle-set.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

sequencer-set.reviewed_property: Failed uptime sources can be replaced without removing down/recovery protection.
scenarios: Wrong caller, zero/EOA/wrong runtime, nonzero decimals or malformed status rejects without changing old policy.
New down/recovering status cannot price operations until strictly past one-hour grace; replacing need not query the old failed feed.
Healthy old transition timestamps do not expire like price rounds; future/inconsistent timestamps and narrow ABI words still reject.
sequencer-set.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

oracle-read.reviewed_property: Positive valuations require valid two-source bounds and conservative integer units.
scenarios: Missing policy, unavailable/oversized/gas-exhausting source, negative/zero/noncanonical answer or stale/future precision/round mismatch fails closed, never0 or1USD fallback.
ETH18/mixed token precision, tiny/large amounts and ratio boundaries remain exactly scaled or reject when unrepresentable; no float/overflow truncation.
A3% agreeing pair can still fail the2% upper-input/lower-LP floor before costs; do not silently use midpoint or widen caller loss.
Policy/round/decimals/sequencer changes alter contribution fingerprint; provider correlation and proxy powers remain externally reviewed risks.
oracle-read.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

precision-read.reviewed_property: Stored token precision is not a fresh usable market observation.
scenarios: No active policy rejects rather than assuming18decimals for an unknown token.
Native precision is18 and admitted token precision is at most18; live priceBounds rechecks actual token decimals.
Precision can be readable while prices fail; callers must not infer price freshness or quote availability from it.
precision-read.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

pyth.reviewed_property: Immutable Pyth reader preserves actual time/exponent/confidence and bounds upstream return work.
scenarios: Changed runtime, wrong feed/exponent, short/oversized/reverting data or gas-exhausting source rejects.
Zero/negative/noncanonical-wide price, future/zero/oversized/stale time or excessive confidence rejects at exact integer boundaries.
Repeated reads cannot refresh publishTime; synthetic round derives from original time and does not prove provider independence/updater liveness.
pyth.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

pricing-phase.reviewed_property: Only fixed Entry/Budget can advance one immutable-basis contribution state machine.
scenarios: Wrong caller/phase/bucket/NFT/packed amounts/gross USD, nested begin, caller cap>10% or governed cap above signed maximum rejects.
Callbacks changing rounds/policy/decimals/spot/limits or late context adoption fail exact fingerprint/phase checks; successful final clear occurs after reset checks.
Zero NAV/share issue, supply ceiling, excessive idle or insufficient net and marginal deployed LP reverts all durable changes; late historical compound is incumbent backing only.
pricing-phase.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

nav.reviewed_property: Bucket NAV marks physical LP and attributed backing, not every raw balance or past contribution.
scenarios: Unknown/uninitialized bucket or failed pool/price/venue retains actual default/error semantics; downstream readers cannot invent a healthy USD mark.
Entirely out-of-range LP becomes one-sided; historical contribution, holder fees, royalties, buyback and unsolicited raw gifts do not become current LP NAV.
Only the matching active contribution bucket uses frozen marks; intermediate callback-readable state is not a standalone collateral oracle.
nav.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

pool-set.reviewed_property: Only governed fixed-ZZZ static/hookless pairs and one contribution pool are admitted.
scenarios: Wrong caller/pair/order/fixed token/native chain or runtime, hook/dynamic fee, bad spacing or incompatible strategy/slippage/minimum bounds rejects.
Second enabled contribution pool rejects until the current one is stopped; historical pools/bucket aliases remain explicit and permanently bounded.
Bad prices/reward admission blocks enable/reconfigure, not dependency-free disable. Static LP fee does not freeze later protocol fees or liquidity depth.
pool-set.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

pool-stop.reviewed_property: Pool disable only narrows existing flags and does not consult failed external dependencies.
scenarios: Unknown pool, wrong caller or both flags false rejects; repeated already-disabled restriction is idempotent.
Disable deposits clears that contribution selection; disabling operations does not silently switch pair/range/caps or enable another pool.
False flags cannot re-enable; full config validation is required. Claims/harvest/raw recovery/canonical lifecycle keep their separate control boundaries.
pool-stop.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

pool-read.reviewed_property: Pool reads preserve actual native currency identity and bound source valuation.
scenarios: Unknown pool rejects; native accounting/isNativePool rechecks exact chain, code and manager wiring.
Stopped admission does not erase historical identity or imply every fee/claim/exit path is frozen.
Only fixed Vault plus exact armed Entry context adopts original-source USD; unrelated reads still require enabled exact source policies.
pool-read.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

range-set.reviewed_property: Governance range settings do not reinterpret current physical ticks or let keeper choose arbitrary width.
scenarios: Wrong caller, invalid/no-op orientation, unsupported thresholds/interval/review or unrepresentable range rejects.
Disable adaptive policy without healthy feeds/venue; re-enable validates configuration and orientation afresh.
Orientation change disables old adaptive policy; settings alone do not rebalance, guarantee fees or forecast volatility.
range-set.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

range-select.reviewed_property: On-chain preapproved displacement rule selects only2500/5000, subject to lifecycle/cooldown/config.
scenarios: Wrong keeper/module, disabled or drifted policy, inactive/missing LP, pause/preparation/canonical lock or unmet cooldown cannot select.
Exact narrow/widen thresholds use ZZZ-price inverse orientation; a pending physical policy change prevents flip-flop before rebalance.
The chosen config width still needs fresh representable ticks and subsequent guarded maintenance; selection is not immediate LP movement.
range-select.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

range-plan.reviewed_property: Plan uses actual orientation/spacing/current independent prices and directional net venue fees.
scenarios: Minimum/maximum tick and negative/nonmultiple spacing round outward to representable ordered ticks or reject.
Entirely outside either range produces one-sided plan; mixed precision/zero/tiny amounts use bounded two-pass/dust cutoff, never an unbounded swap loop.
Manipulated spot/stale source/disabled operations/bad static or directional fee rejects; prices/depth/fees can still change before guarded execution.
range-plan.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

range-due.reviewed_property: Eligibility reflects actual bucket/range/cooldown, not a guaranteed execution time.
scenarios: Missing/inactive LP or center returns false as specified; malformed physical ticks and unreadable dependencies never become guessed eligibility.
Cooldown/flat-price width change and price displacement trigger remain separate; disabled operations block ordinary maintenance.
Due or out-of-range state cannot promise keeper gas/availability or loss-feasible execution; pending width does not bypass guards.
range-due.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

lp-put.reviewed_property: Only Vault can fund/mint/increase its exact physical LP; final facts exclude callback repricing/prefund subsidy.
scenarios: Wrong caller/owner/key/ticks/spacing/minimum/deadline, amount>uint128 or incorrect native value rejects.
Pull/approval/reset/refund callbacks changing spot, owner, ticks or liquidity fail final current-price and exact physical-liquidity-delta checks.
Manager/PosM/native/token prefunds cannot pay principal debt or be swept; exact native debt, Permit2 reset, refund and Vault owner are verified.
lp-put.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

lp-unwind.reviewed_property: Vault-only typed fee collection/close preserves actual receipts versus principal and prefunds.
scenarios: Wrong caller/LP owner/PoolKey/deadline rejects; arbitrary/other owner positions cannot become bucket custody.
Zero-liquidity decrease collects actual fees; close enforces raw principal minima and fixed typed BURN/TAKE_PAIR/native settlement.
Stopped ordinary operations or bad price feeds do not automatically block separately permitted collection/parking, but a permanently broken venue/token can still halt movement.
lp-unwind.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

lp-read.reviewed_property: Physical amount/tick/spot data is not by itself canonical custody proof.
scenarios: Unknown LP, invalid ticks or uninitialized pool propagates actual typed error/state rather than positive invented principal.
Exact lower/upper/outside endpoints produce floor-valued one-sided principal, excluding uncollected fees.
Any caller may read another LP; consuming financial path separately checks Vault owner/full PoolKey/bucket and confirmed block.
lp-read.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

swap.reviewed_property: Exact whole-input fixed-parent swap uses one-shot authenticated callback and output/baseline guards.
scenarios: Wrong caller/manager/payload, absent/reused pending hash, unknown disabled route, zero/too-large input/minimum or bad deadline rejects.
Partial fill, wrong delta signs, insufficient output or dishonest settle count cannot satisfy exact input/output and pending cleanup.
Token/native callbacks injecting value, taking prefunds or changing code/route/static fee fail final baselines and validation; failure rolls the complete swap back.
swap.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

mint.reviewed_property: Exact-price home-chain issuance is dormant and atomically forwards payment without LP entitlement.
scenarios: Wrong value/home chain, pause/preparation/canonical lock, supply/reveal failure or mint-recipient rejection reverts NFT/sequence/payment.
Reentrant mint/activation or recipient callback cannot bypass the Vault mutex or leave partly committed issuance.
Mint adds no LP/shares/membership/royalty entitlement; the direct full-price payment path is not qualified OpenSea gross/net minting.
mint.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

join.reviewed_property: Owner-authorized activation/growth preserves incumbents and credits only genuinely added LP backing.
scenarios: Unminted/unrevealed/already active activation, dormant growth, wrong owner/Entry context/status/pool/plan or too-small USD/minLiquidity rejects.
Old fees/dust/compound and entry-swap income settle to incumbent weights before new shares; no retrospective claim is assigned.
Wrong value/taxed pull/overlarge amount/failed placement/too much idle/marginal LP shortfall or share/NAV ceiling rolls every ledger and user transfer back.
Repeated growth adds no membership; feasible out-of-range ETH activation/ZZZ growth and later independently guarded rebalance preserve shares/claims.
join.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

harvest.reviewed_property: Actual received fees are split once, without principal withdrawal or automatic compound/buyback.
scenarios: Wrong inactive/missing bucket, expired deadline or paused/canonical-locked lifecycle rejects; valid public harvest cannot select recipient/rates.
Raw prefunds/tax/injected native or inconsistent receipt delta cannot become fees; actual PoolManager donations legitimately enter funded fee growth.
Frequent small harvest/claim retains dust/fractions/reserves; price-dependent maintenance outage need not destroy already funded claims or separately valid harvest.
harvest.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

maintenance.reviewed_property: Module/keeper-only maintenance retains NFT shares/rights and captured principal budget.
scenarios: Wrong caller/inactive LP, zero minLiquidity, premature cooldown, stopped policy/plan or invalid oracle/spot cannot trigger ordinary upkeep.
Close/balance/deploy callbacks, fee shock/partial fill/loss must pass captured start-price aggregate cap plus raw venue minima/5%idle or revert.
Only attributed idle and designated compound enter at most two balancing passes; failure rolls back cooldown/state and success changes backing/range, not membership/shares.
Per-operation cap excludes network gas, IL/market loss and cumulative turnover; no implicit generic sweep or keeper availability guarantee.
maintenance.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

move.reviewed_property: Fixed-module movement uses attributed balances, separate approvals and funded recovery, not holder redemption.
scenarios: Wrong caller/status/pair/plan/destination rejects; historical pool aliases use bounded permanent capacity without overwriting another bucket.
Paused parking/raw exit retains exact snapshots/raw minima; normal conversion retains captured USD floor and no automatic slippage bypass.
Return must fund exact ETH value/ERC20 amount before reviewed deployment; external custodian is trusted and return is not enforceable by source.
Pool/chain/token exchange does not automatically move canonical NFT/reward rights; same-actual-pair moves do not silently convert ETH/WETH.
move.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

canonical.reviewed_property: Fixed companion and canonical phase authenticate record/backing writes; no public rescue is exposed.
scenarios: Wrong caller/kind/row/import lifecycle, duplicate NFT or malformed record cannot alter the canonical ledger.
Send/barrier delegates only to the bound companion whose manifest and recipient are captured/authenticated, not user-selected storage/call targets.
Shares/aliases/idle/backing and native funding must reconcile; duplicate delivery or unsolicited post-capture deposits do not create principal or new earnings.
canonical.status: Static source/caller reasoning; not newly executed tests.

receiver.reviewed_property: Only bound PositionManager ERC721 receipt is accepted and receipt alone never changes bucket identity/shares.
scenarios: Arbitrary ERC721/EOA/spoofed receiver caller rejects instead of returning the success selector.
A real stray PositionManager token cannot overwrite stored lpTokenId/key/share accounting by invoking the receiver hook.
Reentrant receipt cannot access Vault guarded financial writers; final physical owner/key/ticks checks remain required.
